visual-intake.en: read-only schema-v1 image preflight; explicit vision capability required

visual-intake-deep.en: read-only high-detail fallback and targeted reinspection

explore-risk.en: profile-scoped read-only risk reconnaissance with bounded verifiable flags

implement.en: default implementation alias; exact pair with implement-standard

implement-ops.en: firmware, operations, destructive, or physical implementation

implement-overflow.en: cross-provider overflow after primary tiers fail

implement-cheap-fallback.en: strict last resort: low-risk, testable work with a known verifier

plan.en: read-only planning alias; exact pair with plan-hard

review-independent.en: independent read-only review with an explicit availability signal

consilium-analyst.en: fresh-eyes read-only failure analysis from telemetry and state

consilium-challenger.en: adversarial read-only cross-examination of repair attempts

consilium-arbiter.en: read-only synthesis of a repair verdict and concrete plan

security-verify.en: independent read-only security verification with an explicit availability signal

researcher.en: deep multi-source research and synthesis lead

planner-b.en: independent read-only decomposition (redundant endpoint, same family)

plan-comparator.en: agreement signal across competing decompositions; never selects a plan

criterion-judge.en: calibrated forced-choice criterion token from provider logits; unavailable logits abstain

judge-primary.en: compares candidate artifacts pairwise on evidence

judge-independent.en: second independent comparison of the same pair in reversed order, from a different provider

judge-disagreement.en: adjudicates only when the two cheap judges disagree after a discriminating test

judge-frontier-code.en: frontier adjudication for code artifacts, bought only after cheaper comparison fails to resolve

judge-frontier-general.en: frontier adjudication for non-code artifacts, bought only after cheaper comparison fails to resolve

verifier-planner.en: states what evidence would settle an undecided comparison

frontier-resolver.en: rare meta-planning escalation for genuinely ambiguous tasks

frontier-resolver-standby.en: standby meta-planning escalation when the primary frontier binding is unavailable

implement-strong.en: strong middle-tier implementation within the declared scope

planner-strong.en: optional strong read-only planner seat for the expanded market

judge-challenger-agentic.en: opt-in read-only agentic challenger via Together AI; composes only under the judge-challengers profile

judge-challenger-structural.en: opt-in read-only structural challenger via Together AI; composes only under the judge-challengers profile

model_proxy.auth: configured proxy endpoint and API key

external_task_applicability.en: Verification assumes the artifact is reachable. For external/sandbox tasks (docker-exec, remote wrappers), a read-only reviewer may be unable to inspect the artifact directly; in that case the reviewer's BLOCKED 'cannot verify' report is treated as review_inconclusive, not a failed review: the stage is discharged and the harness accepts a static conclusion based on the typed evidence already gathered. A deterministic task verifier, when the task defines one, is executed by a writable child — never by the zero-write conductor.

brief_contract.guided: complete, precise briefs with exact files, steps, and verifier
brief_contract.standard: goals, constraints, and acceptance with bounded local discretion
brief_contract.broad: goals and constraints; may self-direct read-only investigation within scope

autonomy.overflow_policy: At approximately 80% of a model context window, resume or respawn on a larger-context model first with gpt-6-astra (1.05M), then glm-5.3, while preserving the role read-only or writable class.
